title: Canonical condensed realizations of the base p-adic coefficients
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and the normed algebraic closure $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with its norm extending the $\ell$-adic norm. Let $E_0\subset\Omega$ be the image of the structural embedding $\iota:\mathbf Q_\ell\hookrightarrow\Omega$, regarded as the bottom finite intermediate field. Give $E_0$ its subspace norm and set $\mathcal O_{E_0}=\{x\in E_0:\lVert x\rVert\le1\}$; similarly $\mathbf Z_\ell=\{x\in\mathbf Q_\ell:\lVert x\rVert\le1\}$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Write $\underline R$ for the commutative condensed ring whose sections on a profinite set $S$ are continuous functions $S\to R$, with pointwise operations [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring].

The maps $q\mapsto\iota(q)$ and its restriction to the unit balls are isometric ring isomorphisms
$$e:\mathbf Q_\ell\xrightarrow{\sim}E_0,\qquad e^\circ:\mathbf Z_\ell\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal O_{E_0}.$$
They induce ring-object isomorphisms
$$\underline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\xrightarrow{\sim}\underline{E_0},\qquad \underline{\mathbf Z}_\ell\xrightarrow{\sim}\underline{\mathcal O}_{E_0},$$
whose components on every profinite $S$ are postcomposition by $e$ and $e^\circ$, respectively. These components and their inverses commute with restriction along continuous maps of profinite sets, and the integral isomorphism followed by $\underline{\mathcal O}_{E_0}\to\underline{E_0}$ equals the rational isomorphism preceded by $\underline{\mathbf Z}_\ell\to\underline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$.
